notes: The face, however, is unarmored but presents a small target.
All mirelurks, except for kings, are protected by a thick shell that is difficult to penetrate, even with powerful ballistic weapons such as the Gauss rifle.
Mirelurk (Fallout 3).because: Shell protects the body (torso x0.5); the face is unarmored but a small target (head accuracy -10); extremities are more vulnerable than the body.

notes: The face is unarmored but a small target, and when charging a mirelurk will often lower its head to protect this area.
Mirelurk (Fallout 4).because: Only the face is described as unarmored, so the rest (torso) is treated as armored (x0.6).

notes: Unlike other creatures, radscorpions lack a "weak point" that can be targeted for extra damage (such as a "head" for a headshot), which makes V.A.T.S. combat and firearms somewhat less effective against them.
Radscorpions also take significantly reduced damage from any shots that hit their legs, meaning that even a Critical Hit from a high-powered weapon will only do minor damage.
Radscorpion (Fallout 3).because: No weak point (head x1.0) and much reduced damage on the legs (x0.4).

notes: They do not take extra damage from shots to the head.
Crippling a wing via V.A.T.S. greatly slows them down and also temporarily disables their ability to fly.
Cazador.because: No extra damage from head shots (head x1.0).

notes: The deathclaws have a substantial level of natural armor and are resistant to damage on their dark, scaled parts, leaving the belly as a weak spot that takes increased damage.
Deathclaws will charge the target while defending their weak belly with their head, making it difficult to land a shot to the weak spot even in V.A.T.S.
Deathclaw (Fallout 4).because: Scaled parts resist (x0.6), the belly (torso) takes increased damage (x1.6) but is hard to hit (accuracy -15).

notes: Her high armor and HP can make her a tough enemy for most player characters, but she is vulnerable in her head, spouts and legs.
Mirelurk queen (Fallout 76).because: High armor (torso x0.6) but vulnerable in head and legs (legs x1.2; the head already takes double damage).

notes: The lack of a hardened carapace means that they have slightly less concentrated armor protection, however, they have superb overall protection, meaning they are not nearly as vulnerable to headshots.
Mirelurk hunter (Fallout 76).because: Not nearly as vulnerable to headshots (head x1.0).

notes: The cave cricket uses melee attacks and has high Damage Resistance which makes it tough to kill using ballistic weapons, although energy weapons are effective against them.
Cave cricket (Fallout 76).because: The wiki has no figure for FO76 creatures; the page says it has high Damage Resistance, so 60% is absorbed.

notes: Unlike other creatures, radscorpions lack a "weak point" that can be targeted for extra damage (they have no "head," for example), which makes V.A.T.S. combat and firearms somewhat less effective against them.
Radscorpions take normal damage when shot in the torso, stinger, or claws, and reduced damage when shot in the legs.
Radscorpion (Fallout: New Vegas).because: No weak point (head x1.0), normal damage on torso, stinger and claws (x1.0), reduced damage on the legs (x0.5).
